algorithms.name: Sparse workbook inventory
steps: Load original and cached-value workbooks without executing formulas/macros/links.
Visit stored meaningful cells, not max_row times max_column.
Sort row/column coordinates; group adjacent populated rows then columns.

Criteria profiler emits all sheet metadata. Only first100 sheets have cells profiled; later empty sheets can be complete, later populated/comment sheets cannot. Generic document reader separately stops at100 sheets. Other caps expose omissions.
algorithms.time: O(N log N) own sorting; actual parser and two-workbook loading costs additional.
algorithms.space: O(N + parsed workbook/library memory); not a streaming memory guarantee.

algorithms.name: Two-axis role and numeric criterion discovery
steps: Group cells by sheet and row/column orientation.
Find item-first header groups and bounds/unit/condition roles.
Stop at next item header or merged section; excluded result/note roles win.
Support split min/max and source units; deduplicate coordinate/operator/value keys; return up to1000 candidates.
algorithms.time: O(N log N) grouping/sorts plus conservative O(N²) downstream header scans.

algorithms.name: Structure coverage and bounded repair
steps: Compare proposed structure to actual cells/blocks/lines.
For text, sort valid ranges and sweep nonempty lines without expanding ranges.
Run independent LLM on every retained150000-character segment.
Deduplicate80issues; fingerprint stable structure+sorted issue code/selectors.
Stop on verified,source limit,no progress or3rounds; otherwise validate/dedup8selectors and reread.

On ordinary non-abort reread/repair failure return retained context and issues as needs_review/limited. If caller/session signal aborted, rethrow without returning retained analysis; session deadline is mapped to timeout by the document-session owner.
Replace complete context with source-grounded repair, then verify again.
algorithms.time: Text O(M log M+L); sheet roughly O(H*N+N*M); Word O(sum claimed block range lengths). Network inference not classified.
algorithms.space: O(M+L) text including line array; Word coverage Set can expand ranges.

algorithms.name: Page-local visual transcription replacement
steps: Process up to30actual pages in batches3.
Validate page/table/block IDs, structure, source alignment.
Independent judge checks original page and transcription.
Retain Map page identity; repair replaces complete requested pages.
Stop within3rounds/180seconds/output budget; explicit partial or needs_review.
algorithms.time: Depends on page content and model calls; <=10batches per full round, judge calls separate.
algorithms.space: 250000characters accumulated transcription JSON plus original images/parts.

algorithms.name: Workbook criteria repair accountability
steps: LLM plan plus deterministic inventory ranges.
Read selected cells in same discovery sandbox.
Ground every criterion/citation and disposition.
Detect omitted thresholds,unresolved regions/source directives.
Force repair even when model followUpRanges empty; stop after2rounds/area limits.
Return all unresolved/drop/limit fields for HITL.
algorithms.time: Selection bounded18 per round; proposal replacement findIndex may be O(C²); detail scan q*NlogN.
algorithms.space: actual cell Map + proposals/coverage; selected coordinate budget24000, detail return6000 cells/read.

algorithms.name: Facts then matching then deterministic verdict
steps: For PDF/image targets only, independently extract up to 300 source fields before the review request; nonvisual targets do not run this facts-extraction stage.
Ask model to match only approved criterion IDs to actual subjects.
Validate criterion IDs and raw item/evidence shape, current document ID and coordinate syntax. General quote existence and physical location bounds are not proved by this admission.

Compute the numeric candidate and assess missing results. Omit optional missing items; confirmed required missing becomes fail unless the criterion still needs confirmation; uncertainty/absent/unreadable/no-evidence guards become review; otherwise apply the numeric verdict or uncomparable-unit review.
After numeric/missing handling, apply the conditions guard, then the category/sample applicability guard; either can override the prior result to review.
When independent extraction exists and the raw value is not absent, cross-check matching field value/unit/certainty; an extraction mismatch overrides the result to review.
Then apply CSV/XLSX display-label correction from one actual source row when its exact conditions hold; earlier matching and guards used the raw label.
Assign the final normalized status to machineStatus and a new UUID; later human overrides change status/audit while preserving this first machineStatus, not the raw model proposal.
Separately compute row coverage from the raw review response, append normalized items and assign document/run completion with the exact predicates in specs/01 section 3 and specs/02 section 2.9.
algorithms.time: criteria.find O(I*C), field/source scans additional; XLSX coverage O(I*E*R).
algorithms.space: bounded field/findings arrays plus source/profile; no indexed search engine.

algorithms.name: Immutable dashboard plan/render/validate loop
steps: Freeze review snapshot; validate up to2000items.
Model produces14-field design JSON with user request/baseDesign.
Trusted renderer emits self-contained HTML with fixed React chart runtime.
One sandbox installs validator once,checks DOM data/file/filter/evidence behavior.
Diagnostics feed next plan,at most3attempts; failed custom path may return marked standard fallback.
algorithms.time: Rendering/snapshot O(payload + chart/file grouping work); network/inference/DOM validator costs additional.
algorithms.space: snapshot copies + HTML1000..8000000string characters; no arbitrary model JS execution.

knownLimitations.title: No measured latency/FPS claim
knownLimitations.description: No performance trace has been executed as part of authoring this supplement.

knownLimitations.title: No universal backpressure
knownLimitations.description: Run SSE has no drain/byte-pressure disconnect and run event arrays are uncapped; activity SSE has its separate512KiB disconnect.

knownLimitations.title: No global UI batch/visibility policy
knownLimitations.description: SSE publishes per event; document.hidden motion suspension and list/table virtualization are absent. Activity dock keeps supplied-array tail100 after validity filtering; on central newest-first snapshots above100 this keeps older tasks, not newest tasks.

knownLimitations.title: No all-linear algorithms
knownLimitations.description: Criteria replacement, header-region scans, applicability/source checks and row coverage contain repeated scans.

knownLimitations.title: No perpetual shared sandbox
knownLimitations.description: Reuse is document context repair, criterion discovery repair, or dashboard job repair; separate phases may allocate new sandboxes.

knownLimitations.title: No unconditional complete source support
knownLimitations.description: Every reader/model has finite page/range/cell/character/time budgets; unread scope remains partial/HITL.

knownLimitations.title: No parser memory ceiling guarantee
knownLimitations.description: Raw bytequota excludes XML/openpyxl/PDF objects, profiles, structuredClone, base64 and HTML.

knownLimitations.title: No network-level exactly once
knownLimitations.description: Run revisions/token gates protect state acceptance, not generic idempotent POST execution.

knownLimitations.title: No read-LRU claim
knownLimitations.description: UI presentation and preview caches are insertion/write-recency bounded maps; reads do not refresh.

knownLimitations.title: No hidden iframe pause
knownLimitations.description: Once viewed dashboard stays hidden across source tab switch; explicit animation suspension message is absent.

requirements: Record source/build/input hashes and environment for every performance measurement.
Test active/pending/cleanup boundaries using deterministic fake SDK dependencies.
No performance pass based only on source presence or this inventory.
Keep baseline equivalence separate from future optimizations.
